name: GetRecordSapConcur
label: Get Record in SAP Concur
description: Retrieves a single record by ID from SAP Concur.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Client ID from SAP Concur App Management.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The Client Secret from SAP Concur App Management.

fields.name: ApiEndpoint
fields.label: API Endpoint
fields.description: The full API endpoint including record ID (e.g., /expense/v4.0/reports/12345).

fields.name: ContinueOnError
fields.label: Continue on Error
fields.description: If true, workflow continues even if the request fails.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The record data in JSON format.

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.label: Status Code
fields.description: HTTP status code returned by the API.
